description: Retrieve the complete public disclosure record for one business, including Evidence Depth (D1-D4), inspected source URLs, multi-source public verification registries, segregated cross-web signals when enabled, visible unknowns, checked_at date, and commercial relationship disclosure.

location.description: Optional city, ZIP, county, or metro name to disambiguate.

name.description: Business name lookup if slug is not known (case-insensitive substring match).

trade.description: Optional trade to disambiguate when a multi-trade business appears in multiple cohorts.

name: get_business_record
title: Get a full source-linked business record
